name: voice-agent-backend
description: FastAPI backend: Agno AgentOS text chat, plus the token, tool-relay and LLM-proxy endpoints the AssemblyAI voice agent needs.

PROJECT_PATH.description: Deploy the backend/ subdirectory. The repo root holds a package.json for the frontend, which would otherwise be detected instead, and a stale pyproject.toml missing psycopg, pgvector, composio and httpx.

ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY.description: AssemblyAI key for the Voice Agent API. Never reaches the browser.

LLM_PROXY_SECRET.description: Shared secret sent as the llm[].api_key and checked on arrival, so the public proxy endpoint isn't open. Any long random string.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Exact browser origins allowed to call this API with credentials, comma-separated (e.g. https://your-site.vercel.app). Scheme + host, no trailing slash, NO wildcard: a browser refuses to send the visitor cookie to '*', so a wildcard here breaks every request rather than loosening one.

VISITOR_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Must be true in production. The visitor cookie uses SameSite=None so it survives the cross-site hop from the frontend, and SameSite=None requires Secure. Set false only for local http development.

VISITOR_COOKIE_NAME.description: Name of the opaque HttpOnly cookie that groups one browser's chat sessions.

VISITOR_COOKIE_DAYS.description: Days before the visitor cookie expires. Not rolling: a returning visitor past this is a new visitor.

LLM_PROXY_URL.description: Public URL of this app's /api/llm endpoint, e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com/api/llm. AssemblyAI calls it server-to-server, so it can never be localhost — voice connects and then silently fails if this is wrong.

ASSEMBLYAI_AGENT_ID.description: The stored AssemblyAI agent. Created by scripts/provision_agent.py; the API rejects an inline llm config, so this is required for voice.

SITE_URL.description: Public site URL, used in the agent persona and link guardrails.

VOICE_TOKEN_RATE_LIMIT.description: Max voice session tokens per window per client. Each token opens a billed AssemblyAI session.

LIVEKIT_URL.description: Optional. Only used when the frontend runs NEXT_PUBLIC_VOICE_PROVIDER=livekit; the default AssemblyAI path ignores it.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional. Primary text/voice model provider when set.

LEAD_NOTIFY_EMAIL.description: Optional. Where captured leads are emailed. Unset disables lead notification; the row is still written.

LEAD_SMTP_USER.description: Optional. SMTP account for lead notification.

LEAD_SMTP_APP_PASSWORD.description: Optional. SMTP app password for LEAD_SMTP_USER.
